name: 39183 · Vicksburg, MS
findings: ZIP 39183 (Vicksburg) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39183 (Vicksburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 39183 (Vicksburg) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
